name: Amity University Uttar Pradesh Noida
semiconductor_relevance: None -- Amity University is an educational institution with no direct involvement in the semiconductor industry
summary: Amity University Uttar Pradesh Noida is a leading private educational institution in India, offering a wide range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. It is recognized for its industry-focused curriculum and research excellence but does not have a direct role in the semiconductor value chain.
